instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot. In a bright, minimalist indoor dance studio with white walls, the dark-haired girl in a beige long-sleeve top and shorts (R1) crouches on the floor in the foreground, looking down to the side. Behind her, the blonde girl in a beige long-sleeve top (R5) performs the same crouching floor stretch, looking forward-right. Both girls are spaced apart on the light grey floor, executing a synchronized warm-up routine. Soft, diffused natural light fills the space, creating a clean, neutral color palette of beige and white.
